description: This file is a server-side component for a Leads page in a CRM application built with SvelteKit. It includes functions to load lead data, handle CRUD operations, manage lead status, and fetch detailed lead information. It interacts with a Django REST API backend, utilizing various API endpoints for leads, tags, users, contacts, and teams.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches list of leads along with additional related data such as tags, users, contacts, and teams, applying filters and pagination based on URL parameters. Transforms backend response to frontend structure.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Creates a new lead using submitted form data, with validation and data transformation.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Updates an existing lead identified by leadId, applying changes from form data.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified lead by leadId.

methods.name: actions.convert
methods.description: Marks a lead as converted by updating its status.

methods.name: actions.duplicate
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing lead with a modified title.

methods.name: actions.updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a lead via drag-and-drop in a Kanban view.

methods.name: actions.getLead
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a single lead, transforming data for frontend display.
